observations.note: The rhythm section anchors a solid peak while the sitar delivers rapid, energetic runs.
The sitar competes slightly with the rhythm guitar's mid-frequencies but remains followable.
Higher sitar melody lines cut through the dense heavy mix much more effectively.
The rhythm guitars provide decent weight but sound slightly digitized and lack true low-end depth.
The palm-muted chugging sections offer a tighter, more authentic metal feel.
Drums and bass lock into a steady foundation that dependably pushes the track forward.
There is minor frequency masking in the low-mids due to the dense arrangement.
The final decay of the instruments cuts off abruptly instead of fading out naturally.
The immediate fusion of traditional sitar melodies with heavy instrumentation fits the progressive prompt well.

overall_note: A solid fusion track that successfully blends sitar with a driving metal rhythm section, though minor EQ tweaks would help the lead cut through the midrange.
